question: Mayiladumparai, which was notified in 2022 as the oldest Iron Age site in the Indian subcontinent, is in which of the following states in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mayiladumparai** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• It was notified in **2022** as the **oldest Iron Age site** in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Recent excavations at Mayiladumparai have unearthed evidence of **Iron usage dating back to 2172 BCE**, making it one of the earliest sites of Iron Age activity in India.
 
• The findings indicate that Tamil Nadu had a **well-established Iron Age culture** much earlier than previously thought.
 
• Mayiladumparai is significant for understanding the **transition from the Neolithic to the Iron Age** in southern India.
 
• These discoveries are important for tracing the **development of metallurgy** and its impact on social and economic structures in ancient Tamil Nadu.
 
• The excavations were conducted under the supervision of the **Department of Archaeology, Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• Maharashtra is home to several prominent archaeological sites, including the **Ajanta and Ellora Caves**, which are UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
 
• The state is also known for its **Satavahana dynasty**, which contributed significantly to trade and culture in ancient India.
 
 
 
• **Kerala**__
 __
 
• Kerala has a rich history of trade and cultural exchanges, especially through its **port of Muziris**, which was a hub for international trade during ancient times.
 
• The state is famous for its **Neolithic rock engravings** found in Edakkal caves.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**__
 
 
• Karnataka is known for its **Hampi**, the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The state also has significant Iron Age sites such as **Hirebenakal**, known for megalithic structures.
